claiming-items.text: The spirit looks at you without saying a word. However, as you approach, he offers you some items.
If claiming items would result in more than 28 items inside the bag of supplies:

steps.text: The spirit gives you a strange look. You don't have enough room in your supply bag for what he's offering.

after-claiming-items.text: The spirit gives you a strange look. You've clearly claimed all you can for now.
